Heard.
2. Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 18.12.2025.
Learned APP waives service of notice on behalf of Respondent/State.

3. Learned Counsel Mr. Salunke for the Applicant submits that the letter was issued by the Applicant to the IDBI Bank,
Bansarola, dated 14.03.2024 as the co-accused Smt. Manisha Pansare was transferred at Sub Center Isthal as Nurse (ANM).
The account is to be operated by the Medical Officer and the existing Nurse Midwife (ANM).
As such in view of transfer of actual 903.aba2131.25.odt 1 of 3  employee, the name of Manisha Pansare was suggested to be included in the bank for the joint signature for operation of the account.

sentences.text:
Pansare has withdrawn the amount of Rs.1,16,694/- without there being any change carried out by the concerned bank despite of the letter issued by the Applicant, dated 14.03.2024.
4.
Thus, taking into consideration the nature of allegations as against the Applicant, I am inclined to protect the Applicant till the investigation papers are received.
Hence the following order:-

ORDER (I) In the event of arrest of the Applicant - Momin Mohd. Ejazuddin Mohd. Khamroddin, he be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount, in connection with Crime No.0277/2025 registered with Yusufwadgaon Police Station, District Beed, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 409 r/w 34 of the I.P.C. on the following conditions:

(a) The Applicant is directed to attend the concerned police station and report to the Investigating Officer once in a week on every Wednesday between 12:00 p.m. to 02:00 p.m. and co-operate with the Investigating Officer.
(b) The Applicant shall not tamper with the evidence and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and 903.aba2131.25.odt 2 of 3 when required, apart from the day already mentioned above.
(c) The Investigating Officer shall make the investigation papers available for perusal of this Court.
(d) The learned APP is directed to take instructions as regards the material collected against the Applicant/accused.

(MEHROZ K. PATHAN, J) ssp 903.aba2131.25.odt 3 of 3 Momin Mohd. Ejazuddin Mohd. Khamroddin vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97763048/
